question: Which restaurant comes up first when traveling toward Five Wells Roping Rodeo Arena, TX from Sherwood Forest Faire, McDade, TX?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.166138 30.231527)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.402227 30.995182)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.166138 30.231527)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.166138 30.231527)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Five Wells Roping Rodeo Arena, TX
